newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle market slow at $64.50 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle market slow at $64.50 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow, with a few sales slaughter steers and heifers $0.50 per cwt lower, USDA said. Inquiry moderate, demand light.

Sales confirmed on 600 slaughter steers and 900 slaughter heifers Friday. This week's confirmed sales 85,100 cattle including 21,700 head or about 25 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1250 lbs 64.50, pen 64.00. Slaughter heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1150 lbs 64.50.
Confirmed - 1,500 last week - none last year - 100
